capabilities: Create project notes with name, status, due date, priority, and description
Attach milestones with due dates to projects
Log progress updates with percent-complete values
Display projects in a kanban sidebar grouped by status
Archive project notes into an Archive subfolder
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage projects with status, milestones, and progress tracking across notes.
summary: Project tracker that stores projects, milestones, and progress updates as markdown notes and shows them in a kanban-style sidebar.
